Subject: Intimation of Schedule of Earnings Call 
Dear Sir/Ma’am, 
Pursuant to Regulation 30(6) read with Para A of Schedule III of the Securities and Exchange Board of 
India (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, we wish to inform that an 
Earnings Call for all Investors/General public is scheduled to be held on Tuesday, October 27, 2026 at 
3:00 P.M. (IST) to discuss the Operational and Financial performance of the Company for the 2nd 
Quarter and Half Year ended September 30, 2026 as per details enclosed. 
 
The aforesaid information shall also be made available on the website of the Company at 
http://www.lumaxworld.in/lumaxautotech 
 
This is for your information and records. 
 
Thanking you, 
For Lumax Auto Technologies Limited
